errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The change was refused: by the organization's gateway, or as the account may not make it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

warning.description: Set when the change was made only in part, saying what is left.

main.description: As the organization itself, or one of its admins, asks the organization's gateway to take the account out (dev.knotless.removeOrgMember). Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview acts with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session call the organization's gateway themselves.

description: Takes an account out of an organization as the account logged in to this appview's pages, or withdraws its invitation, as `knotless org remove` does.
